description: Saves your working state when you step away and shows it to you when you come back. Made for people who lose the thread with every interruption.
config.idleMinutes: Minutes without activity before a session is saved automatically. Minimum 5.
config.summary.provider: Provider for the AI summary. With "none", nothing is sent anywhere.
config.summary.ollamaEndpoint: Ollama (or compatible) endpoint for the local summary.
config.telemetry: Once a week, send how many times you used "I'm back". Just the number.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Retramo runs git inside the repository, and a repository's configuration can run commands. Like VS Code's own Git extension, it only runs in trusted workspaces.
